description: The first stable, full-featured release of YokaiVerse. This milestone marks the transition from active early development to a polished, production-ready platform.

items.desc: Full stable release with all core features finalized and thoroughly tested.
Complete localization support across all planned languages.
Platform-wide performance optimization for all device types and connection speeds.
Comprehensive accessibility improvements throughout the interface.
Public API for third-party integrations and community-built tools.
Native mobile application for iOS and Android.
